title: Asset meta
description: The meta.json of a Clip or a Sequence (same shape). Frame pixel size is never stored here: it is the Character's Canvas. See docs/format-spec.md.

id.description: Asset id; must equal the folder name.

frameCount.description: Number of frames; the sheet is frameCount frames laid out left to right.

timing.description: Frame timing: one base duration, plus the frames that deviate from it. See docs/format-spec.md Rule 5.1.

frameMs.description: Base frame duration in ms; every frame without an override uses this.

overrideMs.description: Frame index -> duration for the frames that deviate from frameMs. Omitted when every frame is uniform.
